changes: The dist promotion pipeline now restores executable bits for every declared package bin before eviction, rejects symlink and parent-chain escapes, and keeps wrapper wiring covered. Global runtime checks now bind the PATH-resolved command to the canonical package target on POSIX, honor PATHEXT order and executable shim semantics on Windows, reject unreadable or non-invoking shims, and fail closed when canonical-main discovery is unavailable in a Story worktree. The registered regression is discoverable through validation_plan by stable id and label.
usage: Run npm --prefix packages/main run build; then invoke proof-or-stop normally from PATH. For direct regression evidence run node packages/main/tests/red/red-global-cli-exec-bit.mjs and node packages/main/tests/global-core-realpath.test.mjs. Use proof-or-stop validation_plan --explain to inspect the registered red-global-cli-exec-bit validation entry.
expectedOutcome: After any supported dist rebuild, the globally linked proof-or-stop command remains executable and resolves to the canonical package target; invalid POSIX or Windows command paths and unsafe promotion targets fail closed; validation_plan exposes the regression by stable identity.
actualTranscript: Current focused verification passed: package build exit 0; global-core-realpath prints ok; red-global-cli-exec-bit reports live mode 0755 and all hermetic promotion cases GREEN; runtime fact contract verified; validation-tier-planner-smoke PASS including the real validation_plan stable-id-and-label case; git diff --check exit 0.
outcomeDiff: No observed difference in focused verification; full Story validation and independent final review remain to be refreshed before DONE.
limitations: The current machine supplies direct POSIX execution evidence; Windows behavior is covered by hermetic PATHEXT and shim fixtures rather than a native Windows host transcript.
pitfalls: The work required multiple adversarial review waves because superficially correct target strings could still be non-invoking shims, PATH resolution could disagree with the canonical package, and immutable evidence pins required splitting planner discoverability into a new intent instead of replacing the original config-registration command.
